text.zh_CN: 收盘了。第一天最重要的是建立职业节奏，而不是急着赚多少。明天收盘时，你只有一个目标：账户权益达到 10.3 万美元，同时保留至少 40% 现金。
text.en: The close is in. Day one is about building professional rhythm, not making money. By tomorrow's close, your only goal is $103,000 equity while keeping at least 40% in cash.

text.zh_CN: 把 40% 锁死在现金里？这等于主动放弃了四成的资金效率。满仓加杠杆，明天开盘半小时我就能完成一整个星期的业绩目标。
text.en: Locking 40% dead in cash? That's giving up 40% capital efficiency upfront. Go full size with leverage, and I can hit a week's target in the first thirty minutes tomorrow.

text.zh_CN: 市场总在开盘时奖励激进的人，然后在收盘时把他们锁在里面。仓位管理才是职业和赌徒之间的分界线。接不接这个任务？
text.en: The market rewards the aggressive at the open, then locks them in at the close. Position sizing is the line between a professional and a gambler. Do you accept the assignment?

text.zh_CN: 接受。先控制风险，再谈收益。

toast.zh_CN: 目标已记下：收盘时自己对照权益与现金
toast.en: Goal noted: check equity and cash at the close

text.zh_CN: 拒绝。我有自己的节奏与判断。
text.en: Decline. I have my own process and judgment.

text.zh_CN: 很好。打开持仓页，看清楚每一笔资产的风险敞口。明天的每一笔交易，都要能回答“这笔仓位为什么存在”。
text.en: Good. Open the Portfolio screen and understand every exposure. Tomorrow, every trade must answer one question: why does this position exist?

text.zh_CN: 可以。但请把你的规则白纸黑字写下来，并在每个收盘时对照。没有书面规则的自由，通常只是随机情绪的另一种包装。
text.en: Fine. But write your rules down in black and white, and check them at every close. Freedom without written rules is usually just randomness in disguise.
